employers.description: The Menlo Park Fire Protection District is an independent special district headquartered in Menlo Park, CA, providing fire suppression, emergency medical services, and community risk reduction across its jurisdiction. employers.description: The Redwood City Police Department is a municipal law enforcement agency policing a 19-square-mile urban service area in San Mateo County, staffed by approximately 96 sworn officers and 36 civilian employees organized into Patrol, Investigations, and Administrative Services divisions. Civilian roles include parking enforcement, abandoned vehicle abatement, traffic control, and subpoena service. The department is a partner agency for criminal justice and public safety workforce pipelines at local community colleges.

employers.description: The San Bruno Fire Department (SBFD) is a municipal fire agency serving the City of San Bruno, operating two stations (Station 51 at El Camino Real and Station 52 at Earl Avenue) with services spanning fire suppression, advanced life support, and hazardous materials response. Beyond emergency response, the department conducts annual business inspections, public fire prevention education, and community training programs including CPR certification, CERT training, and smoke alarm installation. The department employs firefighters and paramedics trained in emergency medical services, hazmat operations, and fire prevention.

The department also delivers community fire-safety education, wildfire preparedness outreach, and code enforcement. Operational roles include firefighters, paramedics/EMTs, and hazmat-trained personnel.

employers.description: San Carlos Police Services is a dedicated bureau of the San Mateo County Sheriff's Office that provides full municipal law enforcement for the City of San Carlos under a contract policing arrangement. The bureau handles patrol, violent crime investigation, crime prevention, parking enforcement, and youth engagement programs for a city of approximately 30,000 residents. Operational staff includes sworn sheriff's deputies assigned to San Carlos, supported by county-level administrative and investigative resources.

employers.description: San Mateo Consolidated Fire Department is a consolidated municipal fire agency serving Belmont, Foster City, and San Mateo through nine strategically positioned fire stations. All firefighters hold State-certified Firefighter II credentials and EMT certification, with at least one State-licensed paramedic on each Engine Company for advanced life support. Specialized capabilities include hazmat response, water and beach rescue, vehicle extrication, and wildland fire deployment, supported by a Fire Prevention and Life Safety Bureau and an Office of Emergency Services.

employers.description: San Mateo County Fire Department operates under a CAL FIRE partnership, providing fire suppression, emergency medical services, and rescue operations across the unincorporated areas of San Mateo County from five fire stations. The department runs a Fire Marshal office for code enforcement and defensible space inspections, and conducts prescribed burning operations for wildfire fuel reduction. It employs career firefighters, EMTs, fire prevention officers, and support staff, and also maintains a volunteer program.
